beats.say: Olivia Rodrigo's new video has a surprise game show host: David Byrne.
He plays Johnny Johnson, the host of The Big Expectations Show.
It's the video for the new remix of expectations, now featuring Chappell Roan.
Olivia and Chappell aren't singing side by side. They're rivals, competing against each other in a retro game show.
Chappell adds a brand new verse, and producer Dan Nigro even turns up in the video.
So whose verse is better, Olivia's or Chappell's?
